name: Conventions page renders its empty state from the sidebar
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, the Skills Lab sidebar's Conventions link resolves its :repoId template to /repos/<id>/conventions. The seed writes no conventions, so the page shows its heading for the demo repo and the 'No conventions extracted yet' empty state with the Run scan action. Nothing is clicked that would scan — a scan is a model call. Read-only seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (hermetic stack).

steps.label: root redirects to the seeded repo's PRs
empty state renders (seed has no conventions)
